questions.explanation: SSV Network's impressive $15.6B TVL on Ethereum reflects its strong position in the staking pool category, showcasing the growing demand for decentralized staking solutions as Ethereum transitions to a proof-of-stake model. This high TVL indicates significant user trust and engagement in the platform's ability to manage validator nodes efficiently.

SSV Network operates as a staking pool, allowing users to collectively stake their assets while enhancing the security and decentralization of Ethereum's proof-of-stake network. This model not only simplifies the staking process for individual users but also helps to mitigate risks associated with single points of failure in validator operations.
